data.narrative:
Stacked Energy is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Dylan Erb and Sumitha Durairaj that has raised $98M to date. The relevant comp universe for valuation purposes spans 9 private frontier-tech players in Climate & Energy, including peers such as Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen, alongside 1 public comparable (LNZA).

Given the early-stage and specialized nature of the target, a narrow peer-median approach proved inapplicable; the Climate & Energy peer set contained insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables meeting minimum thresholds (0 qualifying matches). Consequently, valuation relied on stage-progression methodology, applying a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the $98M total raised as a valuation proxy, yielding an implied value of $196M. This method reflects the capital intensity and risk-reward profile of frontier energy ventures at this stage.

The triangulation analysis, constrained to a single methodological input, supports a median valuation of $196M, with a sensitivity range of $167M (low) to $225M (high). Key uncertainties include the absence of direct peer benchmarks within the narrow Series A climate-tech cohort and reliance on stage-progression assumptions rather than comparable company multiples. The valuation is therefore most appropriately viewed as an order-of-magnitude estimate pending availability of tighter peer data or transaction evidence.
